rows.headline: Russia and Ukraine trade fresh strikes despite renewed U.S.-brokered peace talks
rows.hook: Strikes continue despite renewed peace talks
rows.summary: Russian and Ukrainian leadership stated they are open to peace negotiations on Thursday, even as overnight military strikes continued between the two nations. Both President Vladimir Putin and President Volodymyr Zelenskyy acknowledged willingness to talk amidst ongoing hostilities. The continued conflict threatens global energy and commodity supply chains, impacting international markets. Indian retail investors should monitor geopolitical tensions as oil and fertilizer price volatility directly affects domestic inflation and import bills.
rows.why_it_matters: Geopolitical tensions could drive up oil prices and domestic inflation.
rows.winners_losers: Oil producers gain / net importers hurt

The company confirmed that the deployment of funds aligns with the plans outlined during the fundraising. Transparent capital utilisation builds trust in the management's allocation capabilities.

CEO Vikas Goel announced plans to include ETFs and Futures & Options as part of a differentiated product suite. The exchange will focus on multi-factor indices and technology to attract retail investors from smaller Indian towns. This expansion marks NCDEX's transition from a pure commodity player to a full-service financial exchange.
